ruff.composition: the F120 baseline, unchanged since it was recorded

rationale: This suite is deliberately not green. F131's RED proves a container ingress bypass that is not yet repairable, so it stays red on purpose. A collector that simply reported red would be ignored within a day, and a baseline that silently followed whatever the suite currently does would not be a check at all — only the delta against these declared numbers is a signal. Update this file in the same change that legitimately retires one of these REDs, never afterwards to make a run look clean, and record the reason in revision_history. The 58 absent-entrypoint-script REDs were retired that way on 2026-08-07 once the scripts existed and were reviewed.

revision_history.composition: 58 absent-entrypoint-script REDs plus F131's intentional ingress-guard RED

revision_history.why: the two entrypoint scripts were written and reviewed, so the 58 absent-script REDs are legitimately retired; measured 1783 passed / 1 failed on an isolated checkout of the pinned commit. Leaving the baseline at 59 would have let up to 58 real regressions pass unnoticed, because unintended_failures is clamped at zero.

home: .github/, deliberately outside integration/topology-rehearsal/ — that path is the writing lane's owned write prefix, and a baseline the writer may edit is a writer lowering the bar for its own work. Here, any edit by the writing lane is an ownership breach the driver can detect.
single_source: both gates read this one file, so the hosted and local baselines cannot drift apart
